name: Megalithic, Bell Beaker & Celtic Europe
summary: From Neolithic megalithic builders of Stonehenge, Carnac, and Maltese temples to the Bronze Age Bell Beaker horizon and Iron Age Hallstatt/La Tène Celts who spread across Gaul, Iberia, Britain, and Central Europe.
keyFacts: Stonehenge astronomical sarsen circle & Newgrange passage tomb
Nebra Sky Disk (1600 BCE)—oldest concrete depiction of the cosmos
La Tène Celtic ironworking, chainmail, and wheeled chariotry

name: England → British Empire & UK
summary: Pioneered Magna Carta (1215), parliamentary constitutionalism (1689), Newton’s Scientific Revolution, and the late-18th-century Industrial Revolution, expanding into the largest maritime empire in history (including the British Raj in India).
keyFacts: Magna Carta (1215), Common Law, and Parliamentary Sovereignty
First Industrial Revolution (Watt steam engine, railways, factory system)
